clauses.scope_note: CC0 section 3: if any part of the fallback license is judged legally invalid or ineffective, the Affirmer agrees not to exercise remaining Copyright and Related Rights in the Work, or assert associated claims, contrary to the express Statement of Purpose.
clauses.condition_explanation: fallback_license_part_invalid_or_ineffective means any part of the section 3 fallback license is judged legally invalid or ineffective under applicable law. use_contrary_to_affirmer_express_statement_of_purpose means exercising remaining rights or asserting associated claims with respect to the Work contrary to the purpose stated in CC0 section 0. The source does not further specify which conduct would be contrary to that purpose.

obligation_items.content: Do not exercise remaining Copyright and Related Rights in the Work or assert associated claims and causes of action with respect to the Work contrary to the Affirmer's express Statement of Purpose.
obligation_items.object: The Work and the Affirmer's remaining Copyright and Related Rights and associated claims concerning it
obligation_items.trigger: If any part of the section 3 fallback license is judged legally invalid or ineffective under applicable law.

coverage_notes: Section 3's fallback license and sublicensing restriction are covered by immutable anchors. Its separate nontransferability restriction concerns transferring the license, an action not represented by the allowed activity vocabulary; it is not equivalent to sublicensing.

paragraph_audit.reason: The fallback grant, sublicensing bar, and Affirmer's conditional restriction on exercising remaining rights or asserting claims are represented by the cited clauses. The distinct nontransferability restriction in section 3 concerns transferring the fallback license, for which no allowed activity provides a faithful representation.
